hero.subtitle: Protect your health with our advanced expert system. Our algorithm combines EfficientNet B3 for deep learning-based skin lesion analysis, with interactive Forward Chaining logic powered by Random Forest for precise screening and guidance.

features.heading: Why YourSKIN?
features.subtitle: Two complementary analysis stages for more accurate and reliable early skin cancer detection.

items.title: Questionnaire Screening
items.desc: Fill out the skin symptom questionnaire — asymmetry, border, color, diameter, evolution, itching, and family history. The Random Forest model calculates your risk score instantly.

items.title: AI Image Analysis
items.desc: Upload a photo of your skin lesion. EfficientNet-B3 analyzes and classifies into 7 diagnostic categories with CLAHE preprocessing for precise results.

items.title: Results & Recommendations
items.desc: Get a complete report — risk level, detected lesion class, model confidence score, and medical advice tailored to your analysis results.

akiec.pesan: A doctor's examination is needed soon. Pre-cancerous lesions can develop into squamous cell carcinoma if untreated.

bcc.pesan: See a Dermatologist (Sp. KK) immediately. Basal cell carcinoma requires prompt treatment but rarely spreads to other organs.

bkl.pesan: This lesion is generally benign. Continue to monitor and have regular check-ups with a doctor.

df.pesan: Dermatofibroma is a benign lesion that is generally harmless. Regular check-ups are still recommended.

mel.pesan: VERY URGENT - See a Dermatologist (Sp. KK) immediately and request a biopsy. Melanoma is the most dangerous skin cancer requiring immediate treatment.

nv.pesan: Common mole that is generally benign. Monitor changes in shape, color, or size regularly.

vasc.pesan: Vascular lesions are generally benign. Consult a doctor for further evaluation.
